parameters.content:
## GET /study-orders/patient

Órdenes de estudio del paciente logueado (tab **Mis órdenes** de `/my-profile`).

**Query:** ninguno.

**SEGURIDAD:** el paciente es siempre `jwtPayload.userId` — no se acepta `patient_id` por query, así que no hace falta el guard `assert_self_or_staff`. Un usuario de staff que llame acá ve sólo las órdenes donde él es el paciente.

Sin borradores. Sin `clinical_notes`, eventos, `review_items` ni datos de WhatsApp.

**Response 200**
```json
{ "code": 200, "data": [ { "id": "...", "order_number": "OE-000123",
   "board_status": "partially_scheduled", "doctor_name": "...",
   "items": [ { "service_name": "...", "is_scheduled": true, "is_completed": false } ],
   "appointments": [ { "start_datetime": "...", "status": "confirmed", "sede_name": "..." } ] } ],
  "meta": { "total": 1 } }
```

parameters.query:
-- $1 = userId del token. Es el ÚNICO filtro: el paciente nunca elige de quién son las órdenes.
-- Sólo campos aptos para el paciente: nada de notas clínicas, bitácora, revisión del
-- agente ni datos de WhatsApp — eso es trabajo interno de la clínica.
SELECT coalesce((
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(o))
    FROM (
      SELECT b.id::text, b.order_number, b.status, b.board_status,
             b.items_total, b.items_scheduled, b.items_completed,
             -- Quién la derivó: el doctor del sistema o, si entró por WhatsApp, el nombre que traía la orden.
             coalesce(d.name, so.referring_doctor_name) AS doctor_name,
             se.name AS preferred_sede_name,
             b.submitted_at, b.completed_at, so.cancelled_at, b.created_at,
             coalesce((
               SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
                        'id', i.id::text, 'service_name', i.service_name, 'quantity', i.quantity,
                        'is_scheduled', EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a
                              JOIN public.appointment_service_catalog x ON x.appointment_id = a.id
                             WHERE a.study_order_id = so.id AND x.service_id = i.service_id
                               AND a.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'deleted', 'no_show')),
                        'is_completed', EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a
                              JOIN public.appointment_service_catalog x ON x.appointment_id = a.id
                             WHERE a.study_order_id = so.id AND x.service_id = i.service_id
                               AND a.status = 'completed'))
                      ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.service_name)
                 FROM public.study_order_items i
                WHERE i.study_order_id = so.id AND i.is_cancelled = false
             ), '[]'::json) AS items,
             coalesce((
               SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
                        'id', a.id::text, 'start_datetime', a.start_datetime,
                        'end_datetime', a.end_datetime, 'status', a.status,
                        'sede_name', s2.name, 'calendar_name', cs.name)
                      ORDER BY a.start_datetime)
                 FROM public.appointments a
                 LEFT JOIN public.calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
                 LEFT JOIN public.sedes s2 ON s2.id = cs.sede_id
                WHERE a.study_order_id = so.id AND a.status <> 'deleted'
             ), '[]'::json) AS appointments
        FROM public.v_study_orders_board b
        JOIN public.study_orders so ON so.id = b.id
        LEFT JOIN public.users d  ON d.id  = b.doctor_id
        LEFT JOIN public.sedes se ON se.id = b.preferred_sede_id
       WHERE b.patient_id = $1::uuid
         -- Los borradores todavía no existen para el paciente: el doctor no los envió.
         AND b.status <> 'draft'
       ORDER BY coalesce(b.submitted_at, b.created_at) DESC
       LIMIT 100
    ) o
), '[]'::json) AS items;
